remarks: Ready to move in. Beautiful 2-storey , 4-Bedroom Home in Starling, offering over 1,950 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. The main floor features a bedroom, full 4-piece bathroom. The modern kitchen with pantry flows seamlessly into the dining area and bright living room, creating an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs offers a spacious bonus room, convenient laundry with sink, two additional bedrooms with good-sized closets, another full 4-piece bathroom, and a stunning primary suite complete with a walk-in closet and luxurious 5-piece ensuite. Separate side entrance provides excellent potential for future basement development. A perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality in a growing community.*EXTERIOR PHOTO IS a 3-d Render Image* (id:67522)
